title: Young trombonists who go too high
summary: He and the interviewer say Bill Watrous and Phil Wilson go into the stratosphere, and nobody wants to play melody like Tommy Dorsey.

story.theme_name: Trombonists: who they heard, admired and learned from
story.community_name: Talking trombonists: who played the slide and how

blocks.x: Well, yeah, I mean some of those guys that are doing, like Bill Watrous (PHONETIC) and Phil Wilson, I mean, they sort of going up the stratosphere almost and it's getting a little freakish, I think.

Yeah, maybe so. You got to watch that, too. They may not be able to go down to earth in there, but you got to get down to earth and whoever comes along now that can play like Tommy Dorsey will make history in the sweet song because nobody can play that tone like he played. I don't know whether you know it or not --
They don't want to listen to Tommy Dorsey. They don't -- who is it, you know?
Well, but I mean, the thing is, they're getting to the stage where they can't really play
I mean, they really can't. They don't know how to bring out a melody.
